email.subject: Studio 9: quick fix for missed bookings
email.body:
Hi Nora,

I looked at Studio 9's site. Two things are likely costing you clients: there's no way to book online, so anyone searching after hours just calls a competitor instead, and the page has no reviews showing, which makes new visitors hesitate before trusting a new salon with their hair.

I fix these for a flat fee, no retainer. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what I'd change and why.

Worth a quick look?

Alex
Northlight Web
